subject: storytime
title: Caps for Sale words
about: A peddler walks about with a tall stack of caps balanced on his head, and when he naps under a tree a troop of monkeys makes off with every cap but his own. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him acting out what the monkeys do.

book.author: Esphyr Slobodkina
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A tired peddler, a tree full of monkeys and a clever way to get the caps back.
